sapience_notes.subject: Carried-Figure Discipline / superseding-note staleness
sapience_notes.value: A task's description-level 'RULING LANDED AFTER THIS RECORD WAS PLANNED' superseding note can itself go stale: this task's note pointed only at an earlier amendment (review-slices-are-declared-tasks.md) and did not account for a later, more dispositive decision record (slice-command-one-path-to-review.md) that overturned the whole task. Premise re-validation at plan time is not a one-time check that stays valid through to the implement dispatch -- a decision record landed by a *sibling* task between plan and implement can silently invalidate an already-written plan with no mechanical trigger to catch it.
